errors.evidence: The description states that the vertical axis is labeled 'в хил.лв.', but this text is part of the figure's caption, not an axis label. The vertical axis itself has no text label.

The legend label for the orange line is 'Оборот (приходи от обичайна дейност)' (Turnover (revenue from ordinary activities)). The description incorrectly transcribes it as 'проходи' (passages), which is a different and nonsensical word in this context.
